routes.name: Temporary Residence (general, Law 6984/2022)
routes.summary: Open to any nationality. Valid up to 2 years and renewable for an equal period. While your application is processed you get temporary resident status that lets you travel, study and work legally.

other: Passport, birth certificate, proof of entry, police records from origin country, Interpol and Paraguayan police checks, sworn statements.
Foreign documents apostilled and translated into Spanish.
Proof of income categories apply at the permanent stage. Temporary requirement not confirmed.

sources.label: Agencia IP: Migraciones on temporary residency (May 2026)

steps: Receive temporary status and later your ID card

routes.name: Mercosur Temporary Residence
routes.summary: For citizens of Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Colombia and Ecuador. Valid 2 years and not extendable, so you must apply for permanent residence within the 90 days before it expires.

other: Valid ID, birth certificate, police records from age 14, proof of entry.

sources.label: Agencia IP: Migraciones on temporary residency (May 2026)

routes.name: Mercosur Permanent Residence
routes.summary: For Mercosur temporary residents. File within the 90 days before the temporary card expires or you lose this option. The card is permanent but renews every 10 years.

other: Proof of economic solvency in one of the listed categories, such as employee, independent worker, remote worker or digital nomad, retiree, property owner.

routes.name: Permanent Residence (general)
routes.summary: Under the general law, temporary residence is a prerequisite for permanent residence. Conditions and fees for this step were not found on a page I could open.

other: Requirements, solvency proof and years not confirmed.

routes.name: Foreign Investor Permanent Residence (SUACE)
routes.summary: Commit to invest at least USD 70,000 and create at least five jobs for Paraguayans, through a sworn declaration and opening a company through SUACE. You get an investor certificate, then a permanent residence card and a Paraguayan ID.

other: Must open a company via SUACE.
Whether the rules changed under Law 6984 not checked.

routes.processing: The MIC page says 10 to 15 business days, unclear which steps this covers.
steps: Submit the pre-migratory form for the investor certificate
Apply for the permanent card at Migraciones in SUACE
Get your cedula from the National Police ID department

routes.name: Mercosur Residence Agreement Rights
routes.summary: Citizens of Argentina, Brazil, Uruguay, Bolivia, Chile, Peru, Colombia and Ecuador can get residence in Paraguay through the Mercosur agreement, no matter the work or study route.
